themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Surge
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints (Uber, Lyft, etc.) spiked to 5 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 1900% increase (z-score: 10.97)—suggesting rapid deterioration in traffic congestion, illegal parking, or driver behavior in Hunts Point.
evidence: 5 for-hire vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1900% spike)
Z-score of 10.97 indicates statistically extreme deviation
Community board budget requests cite Illegal Parking (678 complaints over 90 days), suggesting existing street friction
reporting_angles: Interview residents and delivery workers about congestion and safety near major commercial corridors (e.g., Hunt's Point Market)
Investigate whether TLC enforcement or city parking policy enforcement has changed; map complaint clusters

themes_detail.label: Homeless Outreach Demand Spike
themes_detail.summary: Homeless person assistance complaints jumped to 5 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 900% increase (z-score: 6.36)—coinciding with cold weather season and matching long-standing CB budget request for expanded street outreach.
evidence: 5 homeless assistance complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (900% spike, z-score: 6.36)
Community board has requested 'Expand street outreach' (Department of Homeless Services) for multiple budget cycles—unsolved problem signal
No recent news mentions or constituent services data, suggesting issue may be underreported
reporting_angles: Profile current street outreach capacity in Hunts Point/Longwood; interview DHS workers and case managers about resource gaps
Document where encampments or high-volume assisted cases are concentrated; connect to CB budget advocacy

themes_detail.label: Vehicle Noise Escalation
themes_detail.summary: Vehicle noise complaints surged to 17 THIS WEEK vs. 5.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 216% spike (z-score: 4.96)—suggesting illegal street racing, exhaust modification, or heavy truck activity has intensified in the district.
evidence: 17 vehicle noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 5.4 weekly baseline (216% spike, z-score: 4.96)
Follows general spike in for-hire vehicle complaints, suggesting traffic congestion or enforcement vacuum
Long-running baseline shows vehicle noise is chronic: 196 street/sidewalk noise complaints over 90 days suggests infrastructure/enforcement weakness
reporting_angles: Map this week's vehicle noise complaints to specific corridors (e.g., near Major Deegan Expressway or Hunt's Point Market); interview affected residents
Investigate NYPD enforcement of exhaust noise violations and street racing laws in the district

themes_detail.label: Police & Safety Calls Spike
themes_detail.summary: Non-emergency police matter complaints jumped to 5 LAST WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 900% increase (z-score: 6.36)—paired with homeless assistance spike, indicating potential public safety coordination gaps.
evidence: 5 non-emergency police complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (900% spike, z-score: 6.36)
Concurrent spike in homeless assistance complaints (5 THIS WEEK) suggests these may be linked calls (e.g., quality-of-life complaints about street conditions)
Community board budget request for 'Enhance park safety through more security staff' indicates ongoing public safety anxiety
reporting_angles: Obtain NYPD incident reports for non-emergency calls last week; categorize by type (loitering, disturbance, welfare checks)
Interview NYPD precinct commanders about staffing and response capacity; compare to CB safety budget requests

themes_detail.label: Building Code & Indoor Air Issues
themes_detail.summary: Indoor air quality complaints peaked 3 WEEKS AGO at 7 (409% above 8-week average, z-score: 5.06), while plumbing complaints spiked to 4 at the same time (700% above baseline, z-score: 4.95)—paired with 1,565 heat/hot water complaints over 90 days and CB requests for building inspectors, signaling systemic housing habitability crisis.
evidence: Indoor air quality: 7 complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 1.4 weekly baseline (409% spike, z-score: 5.06)
Plumbing: 4 complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (700% spike, z-score: 4.95)
Heat/hot water: 1,565 total complaints over 90 days—highest complaint category in district by far
Community board has requested 'Assign additional building inspectors' for multiple budget cycles—chronic enforcement gap
reporting_angles: Analyze DOB permit data (210 total filings, 164 alterations) to see if code enforcement has fallen behind building violations; interview DOB about inspector shortage
Profile 2-3 buildings with multiple heat/plumbing/air quality violations; track how long violations remain open; connect to tenant advocacy groups
